title: Cough
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} is an HIV-positive woman with unknown CD4 count who presents with cough, dyspnea, and hypoxemia. She has concurrent candida vulvovaginitis from poorly controlled HIV. CD4 is likely <200 given the presentation with Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia — the most common respiratory infection in HIV patients not on prophylaxis. CXR shows classic diffuse bilateral perihilar interstitial infiltrates. Elevated LDH supports the diagnosis (though not specific). ABG shows hypoxemia with PaO2 >70, so oral TMP-SMX is first-line. Screen for TB, bacterial pneumonia, and other OIs. Start ART based on viral load and CD4. Admit to inpatient/ICU. PCP prophylaxis indicated when CD4 <200.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: General Appearance
stacks.finding: Full exam in HIV patient with broad differential.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: HEENT / Neck
stacks.finding: Full exam. Assess for oral thrush.

stacks.label: Pulse oximetry
stacks.finding: HIV patient with cough — check oxygenation.

stacks.label: Arterial blood gases
stacks.finding: ABG in hypoxemic patient. PaO2 guides TMP-SMX route (PO if >70).

stacks.label: KOH prep / vaginal wet mount
stacks.finding: Yeast infection — KOH prep reveals hyphae/budding yeast in 50-70%.

stacks.label: Hepatitis panel
stacks.finding: Symptomatic HIV — screen for co-occurring diseases.

stacks.label: AFB stain / Mycobacterial culture, sputum
stacks.finding: TB often seen in immunocompromised patients — must rule out.

stacks.label: Pneumocystis stain / Fungal culture, sputum
stacks.finding: HIV + unknown CD4 — PCP testing confirms diagnosis.

stacks.label: Urinalysis
stacks.finding: Perineal pruritis — UA for GU etiology.

stacks.label: LDH, serum
stacks.finding: Elevated LDH in HIV + respiratory symptoms suggests PCP. Rising LDH despite treatment = poor prognosis.

stacks.label: CD4 count / T-cell profile
stacks.finding: CD4 guides prophylaxis and OI risk. <200 = PCP prophylaxis indicated.

stacks.label: Chest X-ray / CT chest
stacks.finding: Classic PCP: diffuse central perihilar interstitial infiltrates. CXR sufficient — CT only if equivocal.

stacks.label: TMP-SMX (Bactrim) / Atovaquone / Dapsone / Clindamycin
stacks.finding: [Auto-split from bundled label "TMP-SMX (Bactrim) / Atovaquone / Dapsone / Clindamycin + Primaquine"] First-line: TMP-SMX PO q8h (PO if PaO2 >70). Alternatives: TMP + Dapsone, Clindamycin + Primaquine, or Atovaquone. IV Pentamidine for severe disease with sulfa allergy.

stacks.label: Primaquine
stacks.finding: [Auto-split from bundled label "TMP-SMX (Bactrim) / Atovaquone / Dapsone / Clindamycin + Primaquine"] First-line: TMP-SMX PO q8h (PO if PaO2 >70). Alternatives: TMP + Dapsone, Clindamycin + Primaquine, or Atovaquone. IV Pentamidine for severe disease with sulfa allergy.

stacks.label: Consult, infectious disease
stacks.finding: ID consult for HIV management and OI treatment recommendations.

stacks.label: Topical antifungal (Clotrimazole / Miconazole / Terconazole) / Fluconazole
stacks.finding: First-line: topical clotrimazole/miconazole/terconazole for candida vulvovaginitis. Oral fluconazole if recurrent.

stacks.label: Refer patient, public health
stacks.finding: Report positive HIV result to Department of Health.

stacks.label: Pneumococcal vaccine
stacks.finding: HIV is an indication for pneumococcal vaccination.

stacks.label: Papanicolaou smear / HPV DNA test
stacks.finding: No recent pap smear — should be done.

physical_exam.heent: Assess for oral thrush (common in HIV).

decoys.label: Prednisone before TMP-SMX
decoys.reason_wrong: Prednisone indicated only if PaO2 <70. This patient has PaO2 >70 — start TMP-SMX directly.

decoys.label: IV Pentamidine as first-line
decoys.reason_wrong: IV Pentamidine reserved for severe disease with sulfa allergy, not first-line.

teach_me_steps.reasoning: CD4 <200 = AIDS. Guides OI prophylaxis. Viral load guides ART initiation.
Bilateral perihilar infiltrates + elevated LDH + positive PCP stain = diagnosis.
First-line for PCP. PO if mild-moderate (PaO2 >70). Add prednisone if PaO2 <70. Prophylaxis when CD4 <200.
Candida vulvovaginitis is most common GYN complaint in HIV+ women. Topical azole first-line.
Sick HIV patient with PCP requires inpatient monitoring and IV antibiotics.

case_summary: PCP pneumonia in HIV/AIDS (CD4 <200). CXR: bilateral perihilar infiltrates. TMP-SMX PO (PaO2 >70). Treat candidiasis. Start ART. PCP prophylaxis. Admit.
